content.value_statement: Mobile apps often expose sensitive data through weak storage, unsafe WebViews, and incomplete authentication. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward secure mobile implementation patterns.
actual_capabilities: Guides secure input validation for mobile UI, deep links, and API payloads.
Recommends WebView hardening with URL allowlists, HTTPS enforcement, and JavaScript restrictions.
Covers secure local storage with Keychain, Android Keystore, encryption, and cache controls.
Explains mobile authentication patterns, including biometrics, OAuth with PKCE, and token handling.
Supports platform-specific guidance for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, Cordova, and Unity.
Provides review checklists for mobile network security, privacy, and vulnerability prevention.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, not automated scanning or formal verification.
It cannot validate a real app without project files, platform targets, and threat model details.
It does not replace mobile penetration testing or compliance review.
This audited package only includes SKILL.md, so referenced supplemental resources may be unavailable.

use_cases.title: Harden a WebView Feature
use_cases.description: Configure trusted domains, restrict JavaScript, block local file access, and define cleanup behavior.

use_cases.title: Review Authentication Code
use_cases.description: Check biometric fallback, OAuth PKCE, token storage, and session lifecycle controls before release.

use_cases.title: Plan Secure Cross-Platform Work
use_cases.description: Define security requirements for React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, Cordova, or Unity mobile modules.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Mobile Security Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this mobile feature for common security risks. Focus on input validation, storage, network calls, and platform permissions.

prompt_templates.title: Design Secure Storage
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a secure local storage approach for sensitive mobile data. Include encryption, Keychain or Keystore use, cache handling, and backup exclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Harden WebView Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a secure WebView implementation plan. Include URL allowlisting, JavaScript policy, CSP, file access controls, cookies, and data cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Mobile Threat Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a threat model for this mobile app. Include assets, trust boundaries, mobile attack vectors, mitigations, validation steps, and residual risks.

output_examples.input: Review a mobile login flow that stores access tokens locally.
output_examples.output: The response identifies token storage risks, recommends Keychain or Keystore protection, adds biometric gating, and defines refresh token handling.

output_examples.input: Plan secure WebView settings for a checkout screen.
output_examples.output: The response lists trusted domain rules, JavaScript limits, cookie isolation, HTTPS requirements, and cleanup steps after checkout.

output_examples.input: Prepare security requirements for a Flutter plugin.
output_examples.output: The response covers platform channel validation, native permission boundaries, secure storage calls, and review checks for sensitive data flow.

best_practices: Provide the target platform, framework, data types, and threat model before asking for implementation guidance.
Ask for verification steps that can be run during code review, CI, or mobile release testing.
Pair generated guidance with platform documentation and security testing before production release.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for generic hardening without naming the mobile platform or feature scope.
Do not store tokens, secrets, or personal data in plain local storage.
Do not enable broad WebView access without trusted domain rules and file access restrictions.

faq.question: What platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, Cordova, Unity mobile, and mobile progressive web apps.

faq.question: Can it write production-ready mobile security code?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation and review, but teams must test generated changes in their app and platform environment.

faq.question: Does it replace a security audit?
faq.answer: No. It supports secure coding and review, but formal audits and penetration tests still need qualified reviewers.

faq.question: Can it help with WebView security?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers URL allowlists, HTTPS enforcement, JavaScript controls, CSP, cookie handling, and local file restrictions.

faq.question: Can it help protect mobile secrets?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends Keychain, Android Keystore, encryption, biometric gating, backup exclusions, and cache controls.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide platform, framework, feature goal, data sensitivity, authentication model, network endpoints, and release constraints.
